Great app, just needs a couple more things. This is a great app, it just needs a couple more things to accommodate more guitarists needs. This app needs to give the user the options of choosing how many strings they have on their guitar, it would be extremely helpful and convenient if the developers made the options of adding 7, 8, and 9 strings for extended range guitar tabs. The other feature I would love to have in the app is custom tunings for each string and custom tunings for 7, 8, and 9 string guitar tabs. This would make creating guitar tabs so much more easy and fun, and with more and more guitarists moving to 7, 8, and 9 string guitars these days, this app would be used by a lot more guitarists. If the developers added the features I mentioned above, it would make this app the BEST guitar tab app on the market!!! Please consider adding these features to this app. It would make it the best app for guitar tab writing.

Perfect for songwriting or learning tab. I use this app all the time! I bought it when I had an android, then bought it again when I got iPhone XR, that how much I like it! 

However, I wish it had a capo option or harmonics option. Any more than that you should seek another app, because too much detail can easily make things more complex,thus driving the cost up, it’s good the way it is.

It’s okay. There is so much missing there is no dots, yes there is ties, however sometimes you might not want to write it that way. Another thing is that you can only have one instrument playing on one thing I would like to see an option on the top to switch instruments, having multiple, and being able to hear them all at once. Another good thing to have would be is more time signatures for instance i needed 6/8 but it wasn’t there, as well as being able to have a percentage of the tempo so you can slowly build up to it, for instance 50% of 110bpm. The list goes on and on, but I think you get the idea there needs to be a lot more put into this for it to be considered perfect.

reviews.text: Useful…but…. For basic tab writing this app is good. I’ve seen that for dotted notes you have to use spaces and slurs but, despite buying the premium version, I can see no way of marking first time and second time bars, codas etc. Am I missing something or expecting too much?

I owe so many of my songs to this app. I’m very much the type of songwriter who can’t play intricate guitar parts unless I map out every aspect of an idea and practice it relentlessly. This app has helped me so much since I first downloaded it (it must have been years now I forget the year), and my finger style playing and songs has significantly improved over the years thanks to how quickly I can get the ideas down on here. 

However the app is not perfect and it still has small things that can be improved, like how changing the title makes a double copy when I just want it to make one, being able to copy and paste chunks of tabs (for when copying each note gets tedious) and maybe a few more different guitar tones aside from just clean and distortion, although I really do appreciate the inclusion of a different tone to begin with.

Overall, I owe much of my success to this app and it’s amazing team. If you want proof my music is at The Sound of Modesty. Thank you to the devs so much, and I hope you guys keep up your amazing work!

If you do that, I will rate you 5 out of 5 stars.

My initial response was: *”Sadly not as good as I hoped” “It seems quite easy to place notes (fret positions) but I am completely baffled as to how to create a rhythm based on dotted quaver - semiquaver pattern (I.e. Blues, jazz). I also can’t work out how to ask the publisher any question so am hoping my review triggers a response. Basically some form of instruction required.”

*** CREDIT TO DEVELOPER for getting back in touch directly and explaining a way around the problem I was experiencing - you have to use the ties to create the extended duration instead being able to use dotted notes . I seem to have a managed to do this handle now. I just need to practice it.***
